bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'DEBUGAI_PREFLIGHT_V2\n'
printf 'HOST_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'HOST_BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'WORKTREE_CLEAN='; if test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"; then echo YES; else echo NO; fi
if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo DOCKER_UNAVAILABLE; exit 81; fi
if ! docker inspect debug-ai-debug-ai-1 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo DEBUGAI_APP_NOT_FOUND; exit 82; fi
docker inspect debug-ai-debug-ai-1 --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | grep -E '^DEBUG_AI_(ROLE_EXECUTION_MODE|CORE_GATE_DISPATCH_MODE)=' || true
printf 'APP_RUNNING='; docker inspect debug-ai-debug-ai-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}'
if ! docker inspect debug-ai-debug-ai-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}' | grep -qx true; then exit 83; fi
printf 'DEBUGAI_PREFLIGHT_COMPLETED\n'
